title: Config.base_url field computed but never read; resolve_base_url() re-reads env
description: config.rs parses KITHD_BASE_URL into Config.base_url (line 64-66), but main.rs ignores Config.base_url and calls kithd::resolve_base_url() independently (main.rs:194). The Config field is dead computation. Either have main.rs use config.base_url directly (after validation), or remove Config.base_url. A reader of the Config struct assumes all fields are consumed.
